shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -45 && rg 'export.*(Provider|configure)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '(TextInput|Provider|Checkbox|Button).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts && cat index.html && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '\\ndist/\\n' >> .gitignore
npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/index.css src/main.tsx index.html"

/bin/bash -lc 'sed -i "s/headless: true, args/headless: true, executablePath: chromium.executablePath(), args/" /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs
node /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs'
/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found' && command -v apt && command -v dpkg-deb"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-libs && cd /tmp/gravity-libs && apt download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libxrender1 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libfribidi0 libharfbuzz0b libgraphite2-3 libwayland-server0 libdrm2 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/gravity-libs/extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /tmp/gravity-libs | tail -5 && git diff --check && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-libs && apt download libxi6 && dpkg-deb -x libxi6*.deb /tmp/gravity-libs/extracted && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc "cd /tmp/gravity-libs && apt download fonts-dejavu-core && dpkg-deb -x fonts-dejavu-core*.deb /tmp/gravity-libs/extracted
cat > /tmp/gravity-libs/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/gravity-libs/font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-libs && apt download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/gravity-libs/extracted && FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-libs/fonts.conf FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/fullPage: true/fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled'/g; s/fullPage:true/fullPage:true, animations: 'disabled'/g\" /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-libs/fonts.conf FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-check/check.cjs"
